ICI-induced pneumonitis: The patient developed new bilateral infiltrative shadows on chest CT after receiving ipilimumab and nivolumab, and had symptoms of fever and dyspnea, which are consistent with ICI-induced pneumonitis. The diagnosis was further supported by the lack of response to antibiotics and the presence of lymphocytosis in the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid.
Steroid-refractory ICI-induced pneumonit: The patient did not respond to high-dose methylprednisolone and prednisolone, which is consistent with steroid-refractory ICI-induced pneumonitis. The lack of improvement in symptoms and chest radiographs despite steroid treatment supports this diagnosis.
